controllerExperiments: learning-based nonlinear model predictive cavity-pressure control

sourceExecutionGate.reason: A PR-only runner QA success does not prove that the publisher archive was retrieved. Dataset promotion requires a non-pull-request source execution plus inspection of its aggregate artifact.

finalAcceptanceRequires: Exact source archive identity and file fingerprints are recorded.
Internal experiment and cycle grouping is established from delivered files rather than inferred from the paper alone.
Time bases and measured signal arrays/columns are identified with units or source-defined semantics.
Measured signals are separated from controller commands, references, predictions, derived features and labels.
Part-mass iterations are not counted as high-frequency time-series samples unless delivered sampled measurement arrays establish that structure.
Accepted measured-sample totals are computed only from delivered measured arrays/columns with ordering/time basis established.
No raw third-party rows, arrays or cell values are committed or uploaded as workflow artifacts.
evidenceBoundary: The authoritative RWTH dataset record is CC BY 4.0 and explicitly describes real injection-moulding experiments with time-resolved pressures, controller output, screw velocity and screw-antechamber volume, plus part-mass-control iterations. Stage 1 only fingerprints and inventories the delivered archive. No dataset-family promotion or measured-sample count is allowed until delivered experiment grouping, time bases, signal semantics and measured-versus-command/reference boundaries are established.
